title: The RNN Homunculus: Learning to Gate Long-Term Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.14279v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning long-range dependencies with recurrent neural networks (RNNs) is difficult because of the vanishing gradient problem. Gated recurrent neural networks like GRUs and LSTMs address this problem and are commonly explained by their ability to create additive copy paths through time. This explanation is correct, but incomplete: useful RNN gate values must themselves be learned, which is typically done with another RNN. We study this gate-learning problem through carefully controlled sequence classification tasks. Our analysis shows that gated architectures struggle when all training samples require long-range memory and thus equally suffer from the vanishing gradient problem. We intervene by adding short-dependency samples which let gated models learn solutions that capture long-dependency samples, but also generalize across different class labels. translated_title: RNN小人：学习门控长期记忆
translated_abstract: 使用循环神经网络（RNN）学习长程依赖非常困难，原因在于梯度消失问题。GRU和LSTM等门控循环神经网络解决了这一问题，其工作原理通常被解释为它们能够沿时间维度构建加性的复制路径。这一解释是正确的，但不完整：有效的RNN门控值本身也必须被学习出来，而这通常需要借助另一个RNN来完成。我们通过精心控制的序列分类任务来研究这一门控学习问题。我们的分析表明，当所有训练样本都需要长程记忆时，门控架构同样会陷入困境，因此也平等地遭受梯度消失问题的困扰。我们通过引入短依赖样本进行干预，使门控模型能够学习到捕捉长依赖样本的解决方案，同时还能在不同类别标签之间实现泛化。当门控被正确学习后，门控RNN的测试准确率可以匹敌甚至超过现代架构（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文揭示门控RNN（如GRU/LSTM）的有效性不仅源于加性复制路径，更关键在于门控值本身需要由另一个RNN学习得到——当所有训练样本都要求长程记忆时门控模型同样受梯度消失困扰，而通过引入短依赖样本进行干预训练，可以让门控模型学会捕捉长程依赖并跨类别泛化，其测试准确率可匹敌甚至超越现代架构。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that gated RNNs like GRUs and LSTMs succeed not merely because of additive copy paths but because gate values must themselves be learned—when all training samples require long-range memory, gated architectures equally suffer from vanishing gradients, yet adding short-dependency samples enables gates to learn long-range memory solutions that generalize across class labels and match or exceed the test accuracy of modern architectures.
